headline: Gold price in Pakistan fell by Rs5,100 to Rs420,536 per tola on Friday, according to APGJSA rates reported by Business Recorder.

card.desc: 10-gram gold fell Rs4,373; international rate down $51 to $3,980.

caption:
Gold prices in Pakistan fell by Rs5,100 on Friday to Rs420,536 per tola, Business Recorder reports, citing rates from the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association. 10-gram gold dropped Rs4,373 to Rs360,541, while the international rate fell $51 to $3,980 per ounce and silver slipped Rs238 to Rs5,530 per tola.
